name: Functions On The Segments
description: You have an array f of n functions.The function f i ( x ) ( 1 ≤ i ≤ n ) is characterized by parameters: x 1 , x 2 , y 1 , a , b , y 2 and take values: y 1 , if x ≤ x 1 . a · x + b , if x 1 < x ≤ x 2 . y 2 , if x > x 2 . There are m queries. Each query is determined by numbers l , r and x . For a query with number i ( 1 ≤ i ≤ m ), you need to calculate the sum of all f j ( x i ) where l ≤ j ≤ r . The value of x i is calculated as follows: x i = ( x + last ) mod 10 9 , where last is the answer to the query with number i - 1 . The value of last equals 0 if i = 1 .
input_specification: First line contains one integer number n ( 1 ≤ n ≤ 75000 ). Each of the next n lines contains six integer numbers: x 1 , x 2 , y 1 , a , b , y 2 ( 0 ≤ x 1 < x 2 ≤ 2·10 5 , 0 ≤ y 1 , y 2 ≤ 10 9 , 0 ≤ a , b ≤ 10 4 ). Next line contains one integer number m ( 1 ≤ m ≤ 500000 ). Each of the next m lines contains three integer numbers: l , r and x ( 1 ≤ l ≤ r ≤ n , 0 ≤ x ≤ 10 9 ).
approach_summary: Build a Segment Tree over the array. Implement point update and associative range query operations in O(log N) time per query.
